# Apps: removed, optional and protected

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/update-generated.ps1 - do not edit by hand. -->

Provisioned (Store) apps are matched by **name prefix** against what the image actually
contains, so entries for apps a given build does not ship are simply ignored. Removed apps
are also marked *deprovisioned*, so feature updates do not reinstall them.

## Optional utilities (`-Keep` / `-Remove`)

| Name | Package prefix(es) | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Terminal | `Microsoft.WindowsTerminal` | Keep |
| Calculator | `Microsoft.WindowsCalculator` | Keep |
| Notepad | `Microsoft.WindowsNotepad` | Keep |
| Photos | `Microsoft.Windows.Photos` | Keep |
| Paint | `Microsoft.Paint`, `Microsoft.MSPaint` | Remove |
| Camera | `Microsoft.WindowsCamera` | Remove |
| SoundRecorder | `Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder` | Remove |
| StickyNotes | `Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes` | Remove |
| Clock | `Microsoft.WindowsAlarms` | Remove |
| MediaPlayer | `Microsoft.ZuneMusic` | Remove |
| MoviesTV | `Microsoft.ZuneVideo` | Remove |
| SnippingTool | `Microsoft.ScreenSketch` | Remove |

Example: `-Keep Paint,SnippingTool -Remove Terminal`.

## Never removed (protected)

Frameworks other apps depend on, `winget` and media codecs are protected even if a list
entry would match them:

- `Microsoft.WebMediaExtensions`

## Preset-dependent

| App | Default | Gaming | PrivacyPlus | Minimal-VM / Core |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft Store (`Microsoft.WindowsStore`, `Microsoft.StorePurchaseApp`) | kept | kept | kept | removed |
| Windows Security app (`Microsoft.SecHealthUI`) | kept | kept | kept | removed |
| Xbox app, Game Bar, Xbox sign-in | removed | **kept** | removed | removed |
| Edge browser | removed | removed | removed | removed |
| Edge WebView2 runtime | kept | kept | kept | removed |
| OneDrive | removed | removed | removed | removed |

## Windows capabilities

Standard builds remove Internet Explorer mode, Math Input Panel, WordPad, Steps Recorder,
PowerShell ISE, Quick Assist, the XPS Viewer, extended wallpapers, and the handwriting and speech
packs of the image language. OCR, text-to-speech (Narrator) and the basic language features
(spell-check, typing) are kept. Core builds also remove OCR, text-to-speech and legacy Windows
Media Player, plus the matching component packages and Defender.
